tagline.en_US: Publish short posts, links and media on a personal timeline that you control. Ech0 includes accounts, comments, RSS and local data storage in one lightweight service.

description.en_US: Ech0 is a self-hosted personal microblog platform designed for publishing short posts, links, and media to a personal timeline. It features Markdown editing with live previews, media attachments, tag organization, and built-in comment moderation. Users maintain full ownership of their data while providing RSS feeds and lightweight social interactions.
